record.original_question: Characterize those Scott well-filtered dcpos P for which, for every Scott well-filtered dcpo Q, the product P x Q is again Scott well-filtered.

evidence.quote: Question 4.9. Characterize those Scott well-filtered dcpos P for which the products P x Q is Scott well-filtered for every Scott well-filtered dcpo Q.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Background and definitions. A directed-complete partial order (dcpo) is a poset $(P,\le)$ in which every directed subset $D\subseteq P$ has a supremum $\bigvee D$. The Scott topology on a dcpo $P$ has as open sets those $U\subseteq P$ that are upper sets (i.e., $x\in U$ and $x\le y$ imply $y\in U$) and that are inaccessible by directed suprema (i.e., for every directed $D\subseteq P$ with $\bigvee D\in U$, one has $D\cap U\neq\emptyset$). The Scott space of $P$, denoted $\Sigma P$, is the topological space $(P,\sigma(P))$ where $\sigma(P)$ is the Scott topology.

A topological space $X$ is well-filtered if for every filtered family $\{K_i\}_{i\in I}$ of compact saturated subsets of $X$ (a set is saturated if it equals the intersection of its open neighborhoods) and every open set $U\subseteq X$ with $\bigcap_{i\in I}K_i\subseteq U$, there exists $i\in I$ such that $K_i\subseteq U$. A dcpo $P$ is called Scott well-filtered if $\Sigma P$ is a well-filtered topological space.

The product $P\times Q$ of two dcpos is taken with the coordinatewise order, which is again a dcpo, and we say $P\times Q$ is Scott well-filtered when $\Sigma(P\times Q)$ is well-filtered.

Problem. Give an intrinsic characterization of those Scott well-filtered dcpos $P$ such that, for every Scott well-filtered dcpo $Q$, the product dcpo $P\times Q$ is also Scott well-filtered.
artifact.status_search_result: Web searches on the stability of Scott well-filteredness under products of dcpos did not surface a published characterization answering this question. Related work establishes that well-filteredness can fail to be preserved under products and discusses sufficient conditions (e.g., strong d-space, coherence) but no source found provides the requested intrinsic characterization, so the status is unclear from public evidence.

status_evidence.title: Commutation of Smyth and Hoare Power Constructions in Well-filtered Dcpos
status_evidence.snippet: Studies well-filtered dcpos and related constructions, but does not provide a characterization of those P with the product-stability property requested.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work continues to study well-filteredness in dcpos without resolving the product-stability characterization.

status_evidence.title: X. Jia's well-filtered, non-sober dcpo
status_evidence.snippet: Discussion of well-filtered dcpos and their relationship to sobriety, including product behavior of Scott topologies.
status_evidence.claim: Existing literature notes subtleties of products and Scott topology for well-filtered dcpos but does not characterize product-stable Scott well-filtered dcpos.
